title: Let religion become clean conduct
summary: The highest religion is not a label to defend but Naam becoming a cleaner way to act.
takeaway: Let Naam prove itself in the next clean act.
lifeApplication: Before explaining your values, make one visible choice that carries them: a fair reply, an honest correction, or a gentler tone.

source.shortMeaning: The best religion is Naam joined to pure conduct.
source.lifeApplication: Let the next ordinary action show whether remembrance has reached your conduct.

evidence.coreClaim: The best religion is Naam joined to pure conduct.
evidence.turn: The shabad measures religion by whether remembrance has entered behavior.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before explaining your values, make one visible choice that carries them: a fair reply, an honest correction, or a gentler tone.
